preparedness.reference_method: Mean of finite eligible counts in the last 13 chronological positions.
preparedness.direction_method: Horizon mean compared with recent reference (absolute tolerance 1e-9).
preparedness.text: Demo projection. Hybrid SARIMA–NNAR: Next 4 weeks: projected increase relative to the recent historical mean. Next 13 weeks: projected increase relative to the recent historical mean. The 26-week and 52-week projected means indicate increase and increase, respectively. The maximum forecast is 3.8 cases around 2025 morbidity week 3. The recent historical mean is 3.1 cases across 13 reported positions in the last 13 weeks. 50 projected weeks exceed that mean; the longest consecutive run is 50 weeks. This pattern may support increased surveillance attention and a review of resource readiness.
